title: gh api user --jq .login
description: The authenticated caller, whose login kit reads in `modules/bash/forge/github.sh` (forge/github:me, and forge/github:require through it), which `modules/bash/tracker/forge.sh` (tracker/forge:me) reaches through the forge. The types are private-user and public-user of GET /user in GitHub's REST OpenAPI description, https://raw.githubusercontent.com/github/rest-api-description/main/descriptions/api.github.com/api.github.com.json.
